decision.reason: [ev-41df2d850c70] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that error messages for StatefulSet immutable fields were "improved" and points to PR #21209. It does not say which messages or code path changed, what the text was before and after, which sync or diff situations produce these errors, or whether anything beyond the wording changes for an operator who does nothing. To write the subject, change, applicability and consequence, we need the PR description or diff, or release-note prose that describes the new behaviour.
